# HexPiece 3.1.0

Your note on the Light fruit's standing pose. Not tested in game yet; the build and tests pass.

- **No more Light fruit stance.** The hands-in-pockets pose (and its walking, sword-held and flying versions) played the whole time
  the fruit was on and held your arms (in the air, your whole body), so punches and other animations couldn't move them. It's gone:
  between moves your body is the game's own (standing, walking, punching, everything as normal), and only the moves themselves
  animate.
- 3.0.9 (green): the sea can't touch you while you're light (Z over water no longer sinks you).
